# Project Design Context

## Project

- Name: pulkit-h-singh-portfolio
- Product type: Personal portfolio
- Stack: React, Vite
- Color mode: Dark
- Density: Editorial

## Visual language

- Background: deep navy `#071525`, with navy surfaces and restrained blue ambient light.
- Accent colors: cyan `#63c8e8` and red `#f0183c`.
- Display type: DM Serif Display; body type: Poppins; utility labels: monospace.
- Cards use sharp, archive-like framing with a small radius.

## Components

- Installed: `warp-carousel` for the writing and media section.
- Experience and writing keep their chronological cards in normal page flow. The nearest card moves forward; upcoming cards rise from below and past cards recede upward. The transitions reverse on scroll-up.
- The opening writes “PULKIT” and transforms it into the cover headline. Portal artwork is not used.

## Constraints

### Must

- Preserve the navy, cyan and red Earth-928 visual identity.
- Keep experience and community roles in chronological scroll order.
- Respect reduced-motion preferences.

### Avoid

- Avoid overlapping experience cards and manual carousel controls.

## Decisions

- Archive cards stay readable in document flow and use reversible scroll-led movement.
- The written “PULKIT” loader transforms into the same cover headline.
